mapper.select:
SELECT NOTICE_NO AS noticeNo, NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, STATUS AS status, CREATED_DATE AS createdDate FROM NOTICE
WHERE NOTICE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
SELECT NOTICE_NO AS noticeNo, NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, CONTENT AS content, FILES AS files, STATUS AS status, CREATED_DATE AS createdDate FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE (NOTICE_NO, NOTICE_TITLE, CONTENT, FILES, CREATED_DATE, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_NOTICE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{noticeTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{files, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, '게시중')
mapper.select:
SELECT i.inquiry_no, i.title, i.content, i.files, i.answer, i.status, i.user_no, i.admin_id, i.inquiry_date, i.answered_date FROM INQUIRY i
WHERE i.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY i.inquiry_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY SET answer = #{answer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, admin_id = #{adminId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = '답변완료', answered_date = SYSDATE WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
